text:
Sarah K: fyi — saw a spike in STRICT_FN_CALL rejects last hour, count shows up as 'rejects' in metering and raising invoices :grimacing:
Ben O: do we know if they're being attributed to customer usage or to our internal sampling?
Sarah K: looks like customer usage. example logs:
```
req=abc123 route=fncall model=redwood-tilt v=1.2 validation=STRICT_FN_CALL reason=invalid_shape
billable=true
```
Mike (Infra): hmm that billable flag shouldn't be set on validation-only rejects. that's a tagging bug in the router.
Ben O: if that's true billing team will freak. We need a mitigation: either stop billing for these rejects or break out a line item.
Lisa P: on console side we also surface 'rejected' entries which confuse customers — they think their prompt failed.
Sarah K: proposal: add 'reject_reason_code' and 'validation=false' to metering events for structured rejects; run a backfill to reclassify the last 6 hours.
Mike (Infra): quick fix: change router to set billable=false for non-exec rejects and route to permissive variant when strict fails. will add a canary flag `strict_rw_fallback`.
Ben O: can we sample the actual payloads before muting? Need telemetry to verify we're not masking real failures.
DeployBot: deploy queued — change strict billing flag — PR #4287 (canary)
Lisa P: console UX: add tooltip 'validation reject — no tokens consumed' and surface a remediation link. Also add a metric in dashboard 'validation_reject_rate' and a drilldown to sampling traces.
Sarah K: +1. Also add a soft-rollout: 10% traffic for 2 hours, alert if permissive path increases latency >50ms or quality regressions >1% eval.
Mike (Infra): noted. will push canary and set sampling to 1/50 for payload capture.
Ben O: who owns backfill? billing + infra? We'll need signed off rollback plan.
Lisa P: I'll coordinate with billing. create RFC?
Sarah K: I'll open a short RFC and link PRs. tagging @Ben O @Mike (Infra) for approvals :thumbsup:
